determination.basis: Work of the United States Government, not subject to copyright in the US (17 U.S.C. §105). NASA's media guidelines: 'NASA content … generally are not subject to copyright in the United States. You may use this material for educational or informational purposes … This general permission extends to personal Web pages.' The quoted page addresses images, audio, video and media files explicitly; the status of NASA-authored text rests on §105 rather than on that sentence. Full text ships in the feed (~6,096 chars median measured).
conditions: The NASA insignia and logotype are protected and are not covered by this.
Third-party material NASA republishes (e.g. partner-agency images) may be copyrighted; text is the target here.

determination.basis: Terms of Use, Content Feeds clause: 'NPR may provide content feeds … consisting of a selection of headlines, summaries or text blurbs, and links to full stories … You may display, excerpt from, and link to the Content Feeds on your personal site or application … you must provide attribution to NPR.' Body use is excluded separately: 'you shall not modify, copy, translate, create a derivative work of … any content' and 'You may not use … any content … to build or train large language models, machine learning tools, or artificial intelligence (AI) systems.' A generated summary is a derivative work, so the feed is permitted and the body is not.
conditions: Display 'NPR' or 'NPR News Headlines' adjacent to the feed content.

determination.basis: robots.txt states the position for our category directly: '# Disallow news aggregators except on RSS.' — named aggregators (NewsNow, news-please) get 'Disallow: /' with 'Allow: /info/rss'. AI model-training crawlers are blocked; user-initiated AI agents are allowed. Read as: aggregators may take the feed, not the article pages. The terms-of-use page is client-side rendered and could not be read by an automated fetch; robots.txt is the cited basis.
conditions: Feed only; never fetch article pages (the edge also returns 403 to non-browser clients — observed 19 Aug 2026).
Attribute Sky News.

determination.basis: robots.txt permits news article paths under 'User-agent: *' and blocks every named AI/LLM agent including user-initiated ones (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Anthropic-ai, cohere-ai, DeepSeek, Claude-Web). conditions: Terms could not be read by an automated fetch — WEAKER basis than NPR or Sky News. Re-check by hand before relying on it.
The feed host is rss.cbc.ca; the path published on cbc.ca 404s (observed 19 Aug 2026).
